bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional path-component resampling, not a full strategy-rule resimulation or search-adjusted evidence
bootstrap.intervals: marginal two-sided95% percentile, linear quantiles; gross/fee/net CIs exported
bootstrap.invalid_draw_policy: Count and retain invalid/nonfinite/nonpositive NAV draws; any invalid draw makes affected CI unavailable, never silently discard
bootstrap.scheme: circular calendar blocks; one index matrix per period, synchronized across all9strategies and all8coins
bootstrap.statistic: Resample daily per-coin gross/fee vectors jointly; rebuild sampled daily net NAV and relink sampled contributions with NEW prior NAV; no signals/targets/fees regenerated

attribution.daily: Within-day link hourly gross and fees to day-start NAV; preserve full730/731/273 strategy days including valid bridge accounting
attribution.fees: 20bps times coin full-L1 ordinary/forced/terminal target changes, with terminal liquidation once and no block-boundary artificial costs
attribution.gross: Held coin weight times valid asset return, linked with NET prior strategy NAV
attribution.net: Gross linked contribution minus linked allocated fees; all eight contributions exactly reconcile period net compounded return
attribution.units: percentage points of initial strategy capital, not annualized and not standalone coin returns

btc_comparison.legacy: Retain exact full-period BTC-only point estimates and HAC(7) intervals from saved shared/metrics.csv; no changes
btc_comparison.matched: Refit BTC-only intercept+slope on exactly each joint model complete-case calendar, using the same calendar HAC(27) and finite-sample correction; report sample separately
btc_comparison.purpose: Separate added-factor effects from lifecycle sample exclusions; alpha may change sign, no new winner

method.classification: post-hoc fixed-basket explanatory attribution; previously inspected history, not a fresh OOS test
deliverables: exactly three updated primary reports with full per-period tables and source inspection
bounded GitHub update preserving existing remote and unrelated dirty local files

joint_model.annual_alpha: 365 times daily intercept; not CAGR or cumulative return
joint_model.beta: dimensionless conditional sensitivity, not portfolio weight, causal exposure or a hedge prescription
joint_model.dependent: saved net simple returns on complete contiguous UTC days
joint_model.factor_day_rule: Every accounting interval in the UTC day must have a finite valid asset return, including valid audited global halt bridges; no missing-to-zero or price forward fill; no return bridging lifecycle/migration cash gaps
joint_model.primary_confidence: approximate marginal two-sided 95% normal Wald intervals
joint_model.primary_covariance: Bartlett HAC over actual calendar lags 1..27, zero score for excluded dates, n_fit/(n_fit-k) finite-sample multiplier
joint_model.regressors: intercept plus all eight basket coins contemporaneous simple daily returns; exact frozen slot order
joint_model.sample: complete cases only for regression; full strategy return and attribution sample unchanged; export every excluded date and reason
joint_model.sensitivity: same fixed design calendar HAC with 7 lags
joint_model.solver: standardized SVD least squares; rank threshold 1e-12 relative to largest singular value; rank-deficient model unavailable, never drop coins or use ridge
joint_model.warnings: standardized condition number >30 or any VIF >10 flagged, never a rule to drop or reselect a model

joint_multiplicity.adjustment: Holm adjusted HAC-normal p-values; Bonferroni243 approximate 95% simultaneous coefficient intervals also exported
joint_multiplicity.limitations: Conditional post-hoc inference, not correction for original universe/configuration/period/strategy-selection search; do not promote significant rows as discoveries

scope_exclusions: no new winner or risk-limit changes

source_policy.reuse: Existing pinned primary/held/target accounting paths, normalized source prices and masks; never regenerate signals or orders

unchanged: all selections and nine-case acceptance decisions
method.user_authorization: All nine frozen strategies across development, validation and Jan-Sep2026; per-coin attribution and joint basket alpha/beta confidence intervals, update three reports and GitHub without changing strategies
